Show polymorphism with the same method name in different classes.

Supplied answer
class Dog:
    def speak(self):
        print("Bhow Bhow")
class Cat:
    def speak(self):
        print("Meow")
for animal in [Dog(), Cat()]: # same call, different behaviour
    animal.speak()
Note: Python does not check the type, only whether the method exists - this is duck typing.
